• Approved by AICTE, NBA Accredited programs.

  2. Information Technology (IT) - Intake: 120 seats
  3. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI & ML) - Intake: 60 seats
  4. Electronics & Communication Engineering (EC) - Intake: 60 seats

  6. Mechanical Engineering (ME) - Intake: 60 seats
  7. Civil Engineering (CL) - Intake: 60 seats

  - Computer Engineering (Specialization in Cloud & Cyber Security)
  - Information Technology
  - Advanced Manufacturing / Thermal Engineering (Mechanical)
  - Structural Engineering (Civil)

rical Drives
• Ph.D. Programs in all engineering disciplines.

1.2 Devang Patel Institute of Advance Technology and Research (DEPSTAR) - Engineering
• Established: 2017
• Focus: Next-generation Computer & Advanced Technologies.
• B.Tech Programs Offered (4 Years):
  1. Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) - Intake: 300 seats
  2. Information Technology (IT) - Intake: 180 seats
  3. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI & ML) - Intake: 120 seats
• Key Facilities: NVIDIA Deep Learning Lab, High-Performance GPU Cluster, Apple iOS Development Lab.

1.3 Chandaben Mohanbhai Patel Institute of Computer Applications (CMPICA) - Faculty of Computer Science
• Established: 2002
• Programs Offered:
  - Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - 3 Years
  - Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (B.Sc IT) - 3 Years
  - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - 2 Years
  - Master of Science in Information Technology (M.Sc IT) - 2 Years
  - Dual Degree BCA + MCA (Integrated 5 Years)
  - Ph.D. in Computer Applications

1.4 Ramanbhai Patel College of Pharmacy (RPCP) - Faculty of Pharmacy
• Established: 2004
• Approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), NBA Accredited.
• Programs Offered:
  - Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) - 4 Years (Intake: 100 seats)
  - Master of Pharmacy (M.Pharm) - 2 Years in:
    • Pharmaceutics
    • Pharmacology
    • Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance (QA)
    • Regulatory Affairs / Clinical Pharmacy
  - Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences

1.5 Indukaka Ipcowala Institute of Management (I2IM) - Faculty of Management Studies
• Established: 2006
• Programs Offered:
  - Master of Business Administration (MBA) - 2 Years (Intake: 120 seats)
    Specializations: Finance, Marketing, Human Resource (HR), Business Analytics, Operations.
  - Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - 3 Years
  - Dual Degree BBA + MBA (5 Years Integrated)
  - Ph.D. in Management

1.6 P. D. Patel Institute of Applied Sciences (PDPIAS) - Faculty of Science
• Established: 2007
• Programs Offered:
  - B.Sc (Hons) & M.Sc (2 Years) in:
    • Biotechnology
    • Microbiology
    • Biochemistry
    • Advanced Organic Chemistry
    • Physics (Condensed Matter, Materials Science)
    • Mathematics
  - Ph.D. in Applied Sciences & Nanotechnology

1.7 Manikaka Topawala Institute of Nursing (MTIN) - Faculty of Medical Sciences
• Approved by Indian Nursing Council (INC) & Gujarat Nursing Council (GNC).
• Programs: B.Sc Nursing (4 Years), Post Basic B.Sc Nursing (2 Years), GNM (3 Years), M.Sc Nursing.

1.8 Ashok & Rita Patel Institute of Physiotherapy (ARIP)
• Approved by Gujarat State Council for Physiotherapy.
• Programs: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT - 4.5 Years with 6 months internship), Master of Physiotherapy (MPT - 2 Years) with specializations in Musculoskeletal, Neurological, Cardiopulmonary, and Pediatric Physiotherapy.

1.9 Charusat Institute of Paramedical Sciences (CIPS)
• Programs: B.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT), Radiology & Imaging Technology, Operation Theatre & Anaesthesia Technology, Optometry.

================================================================================
2. CENTRAL LIBRARY & KNOWLEDGE RESOURCE CENTRE (CATALOGUE & AVAILABILITY)
================================================================================

2.1 Overview & Digital Infrastructure
• Central Library Name: Dr. K. C. Patel Learning Resource Centre.
• Collection Size: Over 105,000+ Print Books, 25,000+ Reference Handbooks, 5,500+ National & International E-Journals.
• Subscriptions: IEEE Xplore Digital Library, Elsevier ScienceDirect, Springer Link, ASCE, ASME, ACM Digital Library, DELNET, and NPTEL Local Video Server (over 10 TB of video lectures).
• Library Automation System: SOUL 3.0 / KOHA Integrated Web-OPAC (Online Public Access Cat

KOHA Integrated Web-OPAC (Online Public Access Catalogue) with RFID automated gate management and smart card book checkout.
• Timings:
  - Regular Days: 8:30 AM to 8:30 PM (Monday to Saturday)
  - Reading Hall (Air Conditioned): Open 24/7 during Mid-Sem and End-Sem Examination periods.
  - Sundays & Public Holidays: Reading Hall open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

2.2 Book Circulation & Borrowing Rules
• Undergraduate Students (B.Tech, BCA, BBA, B.Pharm, B.Sc): 4 Books for 14 Days (renewable twice).
• Postgraduate Students (M.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Pharm, M.Sc): 6 Books for 30 Days.
• Ph.D. Scholars / Researchers: 8 Books for 45 Days.
• Book Bank Facility: Needy and merit students get a complete set of semester textbooks issued for the whole semester.

3.1 Admission Routes & Criteria
• B.Tech Admissions (CSPIT & DEPSTAR):
  - 50% Seats allocated through ACPC Gujarat (Admission Committee for Professional Courses) via GUJCET merit rank.
  - 50% All India Management / NRI / Vacant seats allocated through JEE Main / GUJCET + 12th PCM merit percentage on CHARUSAT portal.
• BCA, B.Sc IT, BBA, B.Pharm, B.Sc, BPT, B.Sc Nursing: Direct merit admission on university online application portal.
• MCA, MBA, M.Tech, M.Pharm: Governed by ACPC Gujarat (throug
M.Tech, M.Pharm: Governed by ACPC Gujarat (through CMAT / PGCET / GPAT / GATE) and University NRI/Management quota.

3.2 University Scholarships & Financial Aid
• Merit Scholarship: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver for top board/GUJCET/JEE percentile rankers.
• Late Shri Chhotabhai B. Patel Scholarship: Financial support for economically backward meritorious students.
• Govt. Scholarships: MYSY (Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana), Post-Matric SC/ST/OBC scholarships, and Pragati/Saksham AICTE schemes facilitated by the university scholarship desk.
• Sports Concession: Up to 50% waiver for state/national level a
ssion: Up to 50% waiver for state/national level athletes and tournament winners.

4. CAMPUS INFRASTRUCTURE, HOSTELS, TRANSPORT & AMENITIES
================================================================================

4.1 Campus Overview & Location
• Location: Changa, Anand District, PIN - 388421, Gujarat, India (Near Nadiad / Anand / Petlad).
• Campus Size: 120+ Acres lush green, Wi-Fi enabled, fully eco-friendly campus.
• NAAC Rating: Accredited with **'A+' Grade**.

4.2 Hostels & Accommodation
• AC and Non-AC Boys and Girls Hostels with 24/7 security, fingerprint biometric attendance, RO drinking water, backup generators, and recreational rooms.
• Mess Facility: 100% Pure vegetarian Gujarati, North Indian, South Indian, and Continental hygienic food 4 times a day (Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks, Dinner).
• Hostel Fees: Non-AC (~INR 45,000 - 65,000 / year), AC (~INR 85,000 - 1,10,000 / year) including food and laundry depending on sharing tier.

4.3 University Bus Transportation
• CHARUSAT operates a dedicated fleet of 60+ GPS-tracked AC and Non-AC luxury buses covering daily routes from:
  - Ahmedabad (all major pickup spots: Iscon, C.G. Road, Maninagar, Naroda, Vastral)
  - Vadodara (Fatehgunj, Akota, Alkapuri, Manjalpur, Karelibaug)
  - Anand & Vidyanagar (frequent 15-minute shuttles)
  - Nadiad (City & Express Highway points)
  - Petlad, Borsad, Khambhat, Tarapur.

4.4 Advanced Computing & Lab Facilities
• Param Shavak High-Performance Computing (HPC) AI Supercomputer.
• 1000+ Mbps high-speed dedicated leased-line fiber internet across campus.
• Apple iOS Lab, NVIDIA Deep Learning Studio, Robotics and Drone Automation Lab.

# CHAROTAR UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (CHARUSAT)

## About University
CHARUSAT is a premier university located in Changa, Anand district, Gujarat, India. It was accredited with 'A+' Grade by NAAC. The campus is spread across 120+ acres of lush green environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure.

## Institutes & Constituent Colleges
1. **CSPIT** - Chandubhai S. Patel Institute of Technology (Computer Engineering, IT, Civil, Mechanical, EC, EE)
2. **DEPSTAR** - Devang Patel Institute of Advance Technology and Research (CSE, IT, AI & ML)
3. **CMPICA** - Chandaben Mohanbhai Patel Institute of Computer Applications (MCA, BCA, M.Sc IT, B.Sc IT)
4. **RPCP** - Ramanbhai Patel College of Pharmacy (B.Pharm, M.Pharm, Ph.D.)
5. **PDPIAS** - P. D. Patel Institute of Applied Sciences (Chemical, Physi

tel Institute of Applied Sciences (Chemical, Physical, Biological Sciences)
6. **I2IM** - Indukaka Ipcowala Institute of Management (MBA, BBA)
7. **MTIN** - Manikaka Topawala Institute of Nursing (B.Sc Nursing, GNM, M.Sc Nursing)
8. **ARIP** - Ashok & Rita Patel Institute of Physiotherapy (BPT, MPT)
9. **CIPS** - Charusat Institute of Paramedical Sciences

## Admissions & Eligibility
- **B.Tech Programs**: Admission is governed by ACPC (Admission Committee for Professional Courses), Gujarat and through JEE Main / GUJCET scores. Management quota seats are filled based on merit.
- **BCA / MCA / B.Sc / M.Sc**: Direct merit-based admission on university portal (charusat.ac.in).
- **Scholarships**: CHARUSAT provides merit-cum-means scholarships, late Shri Chhotabhai B Patel scholarship, and sports/cultural fee concessions.

## Campus Facilities & Hostels
- Central Library with over 100,000+ volumes, IEEE, Springer, and ScienceDirect access.
- On-campus AC and Non-AC Hostels for Girls and Boys with high-speed Wi-Fi, mess, and 24/7 security.
- High-Performance Computing (HPC) Supercomputing Facility (Param Shavak / AI GPU labs).
- Sports Complex with synthetic tennis courts, cricket ground, gymnasium, and indoor sports arena.

## Placement & Training
- CHARUSAT Training and Placement Cell (T&P) connects students with top recruiters including TCS, Infosys, Adani, L&T, Evosys, Crest Data Systems, Byju's, and Amazon.
- Highest package recorded: INR 32+ LPA.
- Strong support for student entrepreneurship and incubation via CHARUSAT Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP).
